q: नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा कुन हो?
answer: नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा देवनागरी लिपिमा लेखिने नेपाली भाषा हो। यसले प्रदेशहरूले आफ्नो प्रदेशमा बहुसंख्यक जनताले बोल्ने अन्य राष्ट्रभाषाहरू प्रयोग गर्न सक्ने अनुमति दिन्छ। (धारा ७, Article 7)

q: What is the official language of Nepal?
answer: The official language of Nepal is the Nepali language in the Devnagari script. However, provinces can also designate other languages spoken by a majority of the population within that province as official languages alongside Nepali. (Article 7)

q: प्रधान न्यायाधीशलाई कसले नियुक्त गर्छ?
answer: प्रधानन्यायपतिको नियुक्तिको सिफारिस संवैधानिक परिषदले गर्छ। यसमा प्रधानमन्त्री अध्यक्ष रहेर अन्य सदस्यहरूमध्ये सभामुख, राष्ट्रिय सभाका अध्यक्ष, प्रतिनिधि सभाका विपक्षी दलको नेता, उपसभामुख र कानून तथा न्याय मन्त्री पनि समावेश छन्। (धारा १४०)

q: Who appoints the Chief Justice of Nepal?
answer:
The Chief Justice of Nepal is appointed through a multi-step process involving several key entities. Initially, the Constitutional Council recommends the appointment to the President, and then the President appoints the Chief Justice based on that recommendation. Furthermore, the Judicial Council also plays a role in the appointment process. 

Specifically, (Article 129) states that the Supreme Court shall consist of a maximum of twenty Justices, in addition to the Chief Justice of Nepal. The President shall appoint the Chief Justice on recommendation of the Constitutional Council and other Justices of the Supreme Court on recommendation of the Judicial Council.

q: धारा २९ मा के व्यवस्था छ?
answer: धारा २९ मा प्रत्येक व्यक्तिलाई शोषण विरुद्धको हक हुनेछ भनी व्यवस्था छ। यसमा धर्म, प्रथा, परम्परा, संस्कार, प्रचलन वा अन्य कुनै आधारमा कुनै पनि व्यक्तिलाई कुनै किसिमले शोषण गर्न पाइने छैन भनिएको छ। साथसाथै, बेचबिखन, दास वा बाँधा बनाउनुसमेत निषिद्ध छ। (धारा २९)

q: What does Article 29 say?
answer: Article 29 states that every person has the right against exploitation, and no one shall be exploited on the grounds of religion, custom, or any other reason. Additionally, trafficking, slavery, and forced labor are prohibited, and acts violating these clauses are punishable with compensation for the victim. (धारा २९)

q: कसैलाई उसको इच्छा विपरीत जबरजस्ती काममा लगाउन पाइन्छ?
answer: संविधानमा धारा २९(४) अनुसार, कसैलाई उसको इच्छा विपरीत जबरजस्ती काममा लगाउन पाइँदैन। यो अधिकारको स्पष्ट दमन हो र कुनै पनि व्यक्तिलाई आफ्नो इच्छा अनुसार काम गर्न निषेध गरिएको छ। (धारा २९(४))

q: Can a person be forced to work against their will?
answer: According to the Constitution, no one can be forced to work against their will. This is explicitly stated in Article 29(4) which states, “No one shall be forced to work against his or her will.” Furthermore, Article 22(1) reinforces this protection by stating that no one who is arrested or detained shall be subjected to physical or mental torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment.

q: नेपालमा न्यूनतम ज्याला कति छ?
answer:
माफ गर्नुहोस्, यो प्रश्नको जवाफ संविधानको सन्दर्भमा फेला पार्न सकेम्न।
संविधानमा यस सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था फेला परेन।

q: What is the minimum wage in Nepal?
answer:
The Constitution of Nepal does not explicitly state a minimum wage. Instead, it outlines how the remuneration for various officials, including the Prime Minister, Ministers, Speaker, Auditor General, and others, will be determined through federal law and government specifications. (Article 79, Article 108, Article 240) 

I could not find this in the Constitution.

q: प्रहरीले पक्राउ गरेपछि कति घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
answer: प्रहरीले पक्राउ गरेपछि चौबीस घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ। (धारा २०(३))

q: How soon after arrest must police bring a person before a court?
answer: Within twenty-four hours of arrest, excluding the time necessary for the journey from the place of arrest to the adjudicating authority. This clause shall not apply to a person held in preventive detention and to a citizen of an enemy State. [धारा ७]

q: नेपालमा मृत्युदण्डको सजाय दिन मिल्छ?
answer:
नेपालमा मृत्युदण्डको सजाय दिन मिल्दैन। यसको व्यवस्था संविधानको १६औं धारामा स्पष्ट रूपमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ। धारा १६ (१) मा प्रत्येक व्यक्तिलाई सम्मानपूर्वक बाँच्न पाउने हक छ र (२) मा कसैलाई मृत्युदण्डको सजाय दिन मिल्ने छैन भन्ने व्यवस्था छ।
(धारा १६)

q: Does the Constitution allow the death penalty?
answer: No, the Constitution does not allow the death penalty. Article 16 (धारा १६) states that no law shall be made providing for the death penalty to anyone.

q: सरकारले पत्रिकाको समाचार छाप्नुअघि रोक्न सक्छ?
answer: सरकारले पत्रिकाको समाचार छाप्नुअघि रोक्न सक्दैन। यस उपधारामा लेखिएको कुनै कुराले रेडियो, टेलिभिजन, अनलाइन वा अन्य कुनै किसिमको डिजिटल वा विद्युतीय उपकरण, छापाखाना वा अन्य सञ्चार माध्यमको नियमन गर्न ऐन बनाउन बन्देज लगाएको मानिने छैन। (धारा १९ (२))

q: Can the government censor news before it is published?
answer:
No, the government cannot censor news before it is published. Article 19(1) of the Constitution states that “No publication and broadcasting or dissemination or printing of any news item, editorial, feature article or other reading, audio and audio-visual material through any means whatsoever including electronic publication, broadcasting and printing shall be censored.” 

Article 19(1) and Article 19(2) of the Constitution.

q: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी संविधानमा के व्यवस्था छ?
answer: संविधानको धारा २७ अनुसार, प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आफ्नो वा सार्वजनिक सरोकारको विषयमा सूचना माग गर्ने र पाउने अधिकार छ। यसको अर्थ यो हो कि, यदि कसैलाई कुनै सूचना चाहिएको छ भने, उनी त्यसको माग गर्न सक्छन् र सरकारले पनि त्यस सूचनाको दिने दायित्व छ। (धारा २७)

q: What does the Constitution say about the right to information?
answer:
The Constitution of Nepal guarantees every citizen the right to demand and receive information on matters of their interest or public interest. However, this right is limited by the need to maintain confidential information as dictated by law. (धारा २७) 

Article 27 states: “Every citizen shall have the right to demand and receive information on any matter of his or her interest or of public interest.”

q: सरकारी विद्यालयमा कुन तहसम्म निःशुल्क पढ्न पाइन्छ?
answer: सरकारी विद्यालयमा माध्यमिक तहसम्म निःशुल्क पढ्न पाइन्छ। (धारा ४०(२))

q: Up to what level is education free in public schools?
answer: Education is free up to the secondary level in public schools according to the Constitution of Nepal. This includes compulsory education at the basic level and free education up to the secondary level provided by the State. (धारा ३१ (२), Article 31 (2))

q: सरकारी अस्पतालमा आधारभूत उपचार निःशुल्क पाइन्छ?
answer: राज्यले प्रत्येक नागरिकलाई आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा निःशुल्क प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकार प्रदान गर्दछ, जस अनुसार सरकारी अस्पतालमा आधारभूत उपचार निःशुल्क पाइन्छ। (धारा ३५ (१)) यसको अतिरिक्त, कसैलाई आकस्मिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन। (धारा ३५ (१))

q: Are basic health services provided free of cost?
answer: Yes, basic health services are provided free of cost to every citizen. (धारा ३५ (१)) Every citizen shall have the right to free basic health services from the State, and no one shall be deprived of emergency health services. (Article 35 (1))

q: सरकारले कसैको जग्गा लिँदा मुआब्जा दिनुपर्छ?
answer: सरकारले कुनै व्यक्तिको जग्गा अधिग्रहण गर्दा मुआब्जा दिनुपर्नेछ। धारा २५ (३) मा यसको व्यवस्था छ। यस अनुसार, उपधारा (२) बमोजिम सार्वजनिक हितका लागि राज्यले कुनै पनि व्यक्तिको सम्पत्ति अधिग्रहण गर्दा क्षतिपूर्तिको आधार र कार्यप्रणाली ऐन बमोजिम हुनेछ।

q: Must the state pay compensation when it acquires someone's land?
answer:
The State shall not, except for public interest, requisition, acquire, or otherwise create any encumbrance on, property of a person. Provided that this clause shall not apply to any property acquired by any person illicitly. (Article 25(2)) 

The provisions of clauses (2) and (3) shall be as provided for in the Act.

q: राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि कति वर्षको हुन्छ?
answer: राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि निर्वाचित भएको मितिले पाँच वर्ष हुन्छ। (धारा ६३ (१)) यस अनुसार, राष्ट्रपतिको पदावधि पाँच वर्षको हुन्छ, र उपधारा (२) मा राष्ट्रपतिले पदबाट हटेसम्म अर्को निर्वाचित राष्ट्रपतिले कार्य सम्पादन गर्छन्। (धारा ६३ (२))

q: What is the term of office of the President?
answer: The President’s term of office is five years from the date of their election. (धारा ७(१)) Additionally, the President continues to discharge their functions until a new President is elected. (धारा ७(२)) The President’s term also ends due to resignation, impeachment, expiration, or death. (धारा ६५)

q: राष्ट्रपति हुन कम्तीमा कति वर्ष उमेर पुगेको हुनुपर्छ?
answer:
राष्ट्रपति हुनका लागि कम्तीमा ४५ वर्ष उमेर पुगिसक्यो हुनुपर्छ। यसको धारा ६४ (१) मा उल्लेख छ।
(धारा ६४ (१))

q: What is the minimum age to become President?
answer: The minimum age to become President is forty-five years. This requirement is outlined in (धारा ६४(१)(ख)) and (Article 64(1)(b)).

q: प्रधानमन्त्री कसरी नियुक्त हुन्छ?
answer: प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त हुने प्रक्रिया केही चरणहरूबाट हुन्छ। सर्वप्रथम, प्रतिनिधि सभामा बहुमत प्राप्त संसदीय दलको नेतालाई राष्ट्रपतिले नियुक्त गर्नेछन्। यदि कुनै दलले स्पष्ट बहुमत नपाउँदा, दुई वा दुई भन्दा बढी दलहरूको समर्थनमा बहुमत प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने सदस्यलाई राष्ट्रपतिले नियुक्त गर्न सक्छन्। यदि उपधारा (२) वा (३) बमोजिम नियुक्त प्रधानमन्त्रीले विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गर्न नसकेमा, राष्ट्रपति प्रतिनिधि सभामा सबैभन्दा बढी सदस्यहरू भएको दलको संसदीय दलको नेतालाई नियुक्त गर्नेछ (धारा ७६)। यदि प्रधानमन्त्रीले तीस दिनभित्र विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गर्न नसके, तर उपधारा (२) बमोजिमको सदस्यले विश्वासको मत प्राप्त गर्न सक्ने आधार प्रस्तुत गरेमा, राष्ट्रपति त्यो सदस्यलाई प्रधानमन्त्री नियुक्त गर्नेछन् (धारा ७६)।

q: How is the Prime Minister appointed?
answer: The Prime Minister is appointed in a series of steps outlined in the Constitution. Initially, the President appoints the leader of the parliamentary party commanding a majority in the House of Representatives (Article 76). If no single party has a majority, the President appoints a member able to command a majority with the support of two or more parties (Article 76, clause 2). If the Prime Minister cannot be appointed within thirty days or fails a vote of confidence, the President appoints the leader of the party with the highest number of members (Article 76, clause 3). (Articles 76, 76(2), 76(3))

q: प्रतिनिधि सभामा जम्मा कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
answer: प्रतिनिधि सभामा जम्मा दुई सय पचहत्तर सदस्य हुन्छन्। (धारा ८४)

q: How many members are there in the House of Representatives?
answer: The House of Representatives consists of a total of two hundred and seventy-five members. (धारा ७) This number is broken down into one hundred and sixty-five members elected through the first past the post system and one hundred and ten members elected through the proportional electoral system. (Article 84)

q: राष्ट्रिय सभामा कति सदस्य रहन्छन्?
answer: राष्ट्रिय सभामा कुल ५९ सदस्य रहन्छन्। (धारा ८६)

q: How many members does the National Assembly have?
answer: The National Assembly shall consist of fifty-nine members as follows: - (a) Fifty six elected members consisting of at least three women, one Dalit and one from persons with disabilities or minorities, from each Province by an electoral college consisting of members of the Provincial Assembly, chairpersons and vice-chairpersons of the Rural Municipalities, and Mayors and Deputy-Mayors of the Municipalities, with different weightage of vote by members of the Provincial Assembly, chairpersons and vice-chairpersons of the Rural Municipalities, and Mayors and Deputy-Mayors of the Municipalities, as provided for in the federal law, (b) Three members consisting of at least one woman nominated by the President on the recommendation of the Government of Nepal. (Article 86)

q: सांसद बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर कति चाहिन्छ?
answer: सांसद बन्न न्यूनतम उमेर निर्धारण धारा ८७ (१) (ख) मा छ, जस अनुसार प्रतिनिधि सभाका लागि पच्चीस वर्ष र राष्ट्रिय सभाका लागि पैंतीस वर्ष पूरा भएको व्यक्ति सांसद हुन योग्य हुन्छन्। यसको अतिरिक्त, प्रदेश सभाका लागि धारा १७८ (१) (ख) मा पच्चीस वर्ष उमेर पूरा भएको व्यक्ति योग्य हुन्छ।

q: What is the minimum age to become a member of parliament?
answer:
To become a member of parliament, a person must be at least twenty-five years old for the House of Representatives and thirty-five years old for the National Assembly. This requirement is outlined in (Article 87). 

(Article 87)

q: उच्च अदालतको मुख्य न्यायाधीश कसरी नियुक्त हुन्छ?
answer: उच्च अदालतको मुख्य न्यायाधीशको नियुक्ति प्रधान न्यायाधीशले न्याय परिषदको सिफारिसमा गर्छन्। यसको लागि योग्यता पुगेका व्यक्तिहरूमध्येबाट जिल्ला न्यायाधीशको हकमा निजले वार्षिक रूपमा फैसला गरेको मुद्दाको अनुपात र माथिल्लो अदालतमा अन्तिम निर्णय हुँदा मुद्दा सदर बदर वा उल्टी भएको मूल्याङ्कनगको आधारमा, न्याय सेवाको कम्तीमा राजपत्रांकित प्रथम श्रेणीको पदमा कम्तीमा पाँच वर्ष काम गरेको व्यक्तिको हकमा ज्येष्ठता, योग्यता र कार्यसम्पादनको स्तरको मूल्याङ्कन गरी नियुक्ति गरिनेछ (धारा ७)।

q: How is the Chief Judge of a High Court appointed?
answer: The Chief Judge of a High Court shall be appointed on recommendation of the Judicial Council. Any citizen of Nepal who has obtained a bachelor’s degree in law and served as a Judge of a District Court for at least five years or who has obtained a bachelor’s degree in law and constantly practised law as a senior advocate or advocate for at least ten years or who has constantly been engaged in the teaching or research of law or in any other field relation to law or justice for at least ten years or who has served in the post of at least Gazetted first class of the Judicial Service for at least five years shall be deemed to be eligible for appointment as the Chief Judge or a Judge of the High Court. (Article 140)

q: नेपालमा कति वटा प्रदेश छन्?
answer: नेपालमा कति वटा प्रदेश छन् भन्ने कुराको स्पष्ट उत्तर यस संविधानमा छैन। तर, धारा ५६ मा तीन तहको संरचनाको कुरा छ: संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तह। धारा २३२ मा संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तह बीचको सम्बन्ध सहकारिता, सहअस्तित्व र समन्वयको सिद्धान्तमा आधारित हुने उल्लेख छ। संक्षेपमा, संविधानमा प्रदेशको संख्याको उल्लेख छैन। धारा ५६।

q: How many provinces does Nepal have?
answer: Nepal currently has three levels of governance: the Federation, the Provinces, and the Local Levels. At the time of the Constitution’s commencement, there were three Provinces, and this number may be adjusted through federal law or provincial assembly decisions. (धारा ७) Furthermore, the Constitution allows for the creation of Special, Protected, or Autonomous Regions, which could potentially increase the number of provinces. (धारा ५)

q: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको अधिकार कहाँ तोकिएको छ?
answer: गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको अधिकार संविधानको भाग १७ र भाग १९ मा तोकिएको छ। विशेष गरी, धारा २१४ मा स्थानीय तहको कार्यकारिणी अधिकार गाउँ कार्यपालिका वा नगर कार्यपालिकामा निहित छ, र धारा २३० मा गाउँपालिका र नगरपालिकाको राजस्व र व्ययको अनुमान पेश गरी पारित गराउने अधिकार गाउँ सभा वा नगर सभालाई दिइएको छ। (धारा २१४, धारा २३०)

q: Where are the powers of local governments defined?
answer:
The powers of local governments are defined in several articles of the Constitution, primarily focusing on the distribution of power between the federal, provincial, and local levels. Specifically, Article 214 outlines the executive power of the Rural Municipal Executive and the Municipal Executive, while Article 221 details the legislative powers of the Rural Municipal Assembly and the Municipal Assembly. Furthermore, Schedule-8 and Schedule-9 are referenced as containing the lists of powers for both the Rural Municipal and Municipal Assemblies. 

(Article 214), (Article 221), (Schedule-8), (Schedule-9)

q: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग कसरी गठन हुन्छ र यसले के काम गर्छ?
answer: अ अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग नेपालमा एक संस्था हो जसमा प्रमुख आयुक्त र अन्य चार जना आयुक्तहरू हुन्छन्। प्रमुख आयुक्तले अख्तियारको अध्यक्ष बन्नेछन् र राष्ट्रपतिले संवैधानिक परिषदको सिफारिसमा प्रमुख आयुक्त र आयुक्तहरूलाई नियुक्त गर्नेछन्। (धारा २३८) यस आयोगले भ्रष्टाचारको अनुसन्धान गर्ने र मुद्दा चलाउने काम गर्छ। (धारा २३९)

q: How is the CIAA formed and what does it do?
answer: The Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA) was formed by continuing the officials who were already in office at the time the Constitution came into effect, specifically those in the CIAA and the Public Service Commission, subject to the conditions of their appointments (धारा ३०१). The CIAA’s function is to investigate abuse of authority committed through corruption by any person holding public office (धारा ७).

q: देशमा ठूलो प्राकृतिक प्रकोप आएमा राष्ट्रपतिले के गर्न सक्छ?
answer: नेपालमा ठूलो प्राकृतिक प्रकोप आएमा राष्ट्रपतिले प्रदेशमा लागू हुने गरी सङ्कटकालीन अवस्थाको घोषणा वा आदेश जारी गर्न सक्छन्। (धारा २७३ (२))

q: What can the President do if a major natural disaster strikes the country?
answer:
The President can declare a state of emergency in respect of the whole of Nepal or of any particular part thereof if a grave emergency arises in a Province by the reason of a natural disaster or epidemic. (Article 273) 

Additionally, the concerned Provincial Government can request the Government of Nepal to declare a Proclamation or order a state of emergency in respect of the whole of the Province or of any specified part thereof, in accordance with this Article. (Article 273)
संविधान संशोधनको प्रक्रियाबारे धारा २७४ सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था छ। यस धाराले संविधान संशोधनको लागि संघीय संसदले बुझ्ने प्रक्रिया र प्रदेश सभाको सहभागिताको बारेमा व्याख्या गर्दछ। (धारा २७४)

q: What is Article 274 about?
answer:
Article 274 is about the amendment to the Constitution. It outlines the process for introducing, publishing, and considering bills that propose to change the Constitution, including provisions for provincial assembly consent in certain cases. (धारा ७) 

Specifically, it details the requirements for amending or repealing constitutional articles, the public publication process, and the involvement of provincial assemblies when the amendment relates to provincial borders or Schedule-6 matters. (धारा ७)

q: धारा ५१ मा के छ?
answer: धारा ५१ मा राज्यका नीतिहरू छन्, जुन राष्ट्रिय एकता, राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा, राजनीतिक तथा शासन व्यवस्था, अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सन्धि सम्झौता, सुशासन, आमसञ्चार र संघीय इकाइबीचको सम्बन्धमा रहेका छन्। यसमा राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा प्रणालीको विकास, मानवीय सुरक्षाको प्रत्याभूति, नागरिकलाई राष्ट्रको सेवा गर्न सक्षम बनाउने, र पूर्व राष्ट्रसेवकहरूको ज्ञान र अनुभवको उपयोग गर्ने नीतिहरू समावेश छन्। (धारा ५१)

q: What does Article 51 contain?
answer:
Article 51 of the Constitution outlines the policies the State of Nepal should pursue, focusing on national unity, security, and governance. Specifically, it details strategies for maintaining national unity while promoting cooperation among diverse groups within the country, establishing a robust national security system, and ensuring human security. Furthermore, it addresses the need to prepare citizens for national service and utilize the expertise of former public employees. (धारा ७)

Article 51 contains policies relating to National Unity and National Security, and policies relating to Political and Governance System of State.

q: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल कुन हो?
answer: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल लालीगुराँस हो। यसले अनुसूची-२ मा उल्लेख गरिएको छ। (धारा ९)

q: What is the national flower of Nepal?
answer: The national flower of Nepal is the Rhododendron Arboreum. This flower is specifically designated as the national flower in Article 3, clause (3).

q: नेपाली सेना परिचालन गर्ने निर्णय कसले गर्छ?
answer: नेपाली सेना परिचालन गर्ने निर्णय राष्ट्रपतिले राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषदको सिफारिशमा नेपाल सरकार र मन्त्रिपरिषद्को निर्णयबमोजिम गर्छन्। (धारा ६)

q: Who decides to mobilize the Nepal Army?
answer:
The decision to mobilize the Nepal Army is a multi-step process involving several key actors within the government. Initially, the Government of Nepal, in conjunction with the Council of Ministers and the recommendation of the National Security Council, makes the decision. Subsequently, the House of Representatives must approve the declaration within one month. (Article 267) 

This process is overseen by the National Security Council, which is comprised of the Prime Minister, Ministers for Defence, Home, and Foreign Affairs, the Minister for Finance, the Chief Secretary, and the Chief of the Army Staff. (Article 267) 

Finally, the President ultimately approves the mobilization following the Council of Ministers’ and National Security Council’s recommendations. (Article 267)

q: विदेशमा बस्ने नेपालीले कस्तो नागरिकता पाउन सक्छन्?
answer: गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकता पाउने गरी विदेशी मुलुकको नागरिकता प्राप्त गरेको दक्षिण एशियाली क्षेत्रीय सहयोग सङ्गठनको सदस्य राष्ट्र बाहेकका देशमा बसोबास गरेको साबिकमा वंशजको वा जन्मको आधारमा निज वा निजको बाबु वा आमा, बाजे वा बज्यै नेपालको नागरिक रही पछि विदेशी मुलुकको नागरिकता प्राप्त गरेको व्यक्तिलाई संघीय कानून बमोजिम आर्थिक, सामाजिक र सांस्कृतिक अधिकार उपभोग गर्न पाउने गरी नेपालको गैरआवासीय नागरिकता प्रदान गर्न सकिनेछ। (धारा १४)

q: What kind of citizenship can Nepalis living abroad get?
answer:
Non-resident Nepali citizenship can be granted to individuals who have acquired citizenship of a foreign country, have resided outside of South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation countries, and have a familial connection to Nepal through a previous citizen by decent or birth. This citizenship allows them to enjoy economic, social, and cultural rights within Nepal, as defined by federal law. This provision is detailed in (Article 14). 

Additionally, (Article 11) outlines the process for a foreign woman married to a Nepali citizen to acquire naturalized citizenship if she permanently resides in Nepal and hasn't acquired foreign citizenship.

नेपालमा आयकरको दर कति प्रतिशत छ भन्ने कुरा संविधानमा उल्लेख गरिएको छैन। 
संविधानमा यस सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था फेला परेन।

q: What is the income tax rate in Nepal?
answer:
The Constitution of Nepal does not specify a particular income tax rate. Instead, it outlines the legal framework for levying and collecting taxes, stating that taxes must be levied and collected in accordance with law (Article 115). Furthermore, the distribution of revenue among different levels of government is determined by the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission, considering expenditure needs and revenue capacity (Article 60 and 250).
